_comment: Copy to config.json (or use the ARTEX_CONFIG environment variable to specify another path). This file contains only database and skill_dir; configure LLM and other settings through environment variables or in the application.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Precedence: ARTEX_PG_DSN environment variable > database in this file. Choose one format: (A) fill in the individual fields below; (B) provide a complete connection string in database.dsn only.
_comment_database_dsn: Format (B): remove the database object above and use a complete DSN. Individual fields are ignored when dsn is non-empty.
_comment_skill_dir: Root directory for skills (each subdirectory is one skill and contains SKILL.md). Precedence: ARTEX_SKILL_DIR environment variable > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave blank or remove this field to use the default. Relative paths are resolved from the current working directory.
